source_summary: Horizontal Chinese landscape with broad blank sky, misty lake, distant low mountains, a rocky pine-covered massif at right, small pavilions on wooded shores, boats on open water, foreground willow groves, a tiny scholar figure, and pale wetland/rice-field textures in ink and light mineral washes.

motifs.name: distant_misty_mountain_chain
motifs.description: Isolate the pale background mountain chain and low shoreline stretching from the far left across the center, including the soft receding peaks, faint horizontal waterline, and sparse dotted tree belt below the hills. Exclude the boats, central pavilions, and right rocky massif.
must_preserve: thin grey contour lines defining the low peaks
soft diluted ink washes fading into the blank sky
broken horizontal shoreline strokes
tiny green-grey tree dabs along the shore
misty gaps and feathered wash edges

motifs.name: left_lake_sailboats
motifs.description: Isolate the small group of sailing boats on the open lake at left middle: one small boat at far left and two larger boats with upright masts and slanted sails toward center-left. Include only their immediate water ripples.
must_preserve: dark angular hull linework
slender vertical masts
triangular pale sail shapes with ink outlines
short broken water-ripple strokes around the boats
spacing between the separate boats

motifs.name: right_rocky_pine_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the large right-side rocky hill/mountain rising from the lakeside, with its rounded summit, exposed crag clusters, dark ridge pines, and textured slopes. Exclude the lower pavilions and foreground fields where possible.
must_preserve: layered rock contours and angular crag outlines
dry-brush texture strokes on the slopes
dark pine-dot crown along the ridge
blue-green shrub washes on the lower slopes
soft mist transition at the mountain foot

motifs.name: central_lakeside_pavilions
motifs.description: Isolate the central cluster of lakeside pavilions nestled against the small hill, with multiple tiled roofs, posts, and warm red-orange wall accents. Include the small surrounding tree and bank strokes directly attached to the buildings.
must_preserve: stacked black roof eaves with upturned tips
fine architectural linework and vertical posts
muted red-orange pigment accents under the roofs
small dark ridge ornaments
nearby shrub dots and pale bank wash framing the buildings

motifs.name: midright_pine_grove_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-right waterside grove below the mountain: a band of upright pines and bare-branched trees, a small pavilion with dark roof and red wall, and adjacent horizontal embankment/water strokes. Exclude the main rocky mountain above and foreground willow trunks.
must_preserve: repeated vertical pine trunks and dark needle clusters
pale blue-green foliage dabs
small pavilion roof geometry with dark ink eaves
thin horizontal water and field-divider lines
misty white openings between tree masses

motifs.name: foreground_willow_homestead
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left foreground homestead under dense willows: the small house compound with dark roofs and fence-like lines, surrounded by large drooping willow canopies, trunks, roots, rocks, and low shrubs. Exclude the lone scholar to the right.
must_preserve: heavy dark willow trunks and exposed root strokes
dense drooping leaf marks made of repeated short strokes
black roof and wall geometry of the small house
fence or railing linework beside the building
rocky foreground mounds with dry-brush texture and dark shrub dots

motifs.name: lone_scholar_with_staff
motifs.description: Isolate the tiny walking scholar figure on the foreground path near lower center-left, including the peach robe, bent posture, dark head, legs, and slender walking staff. Include only the minimal ground strokes immediately under the figure.
must_preserve: small peach-colored robe wash
fine black outline of body and limbs
slender diagonal walking staff
dark head and compact posture
tiny ground/path strokes at the feet

motifs.name: lower_right_wet_fields
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right open wet fields and low earthen banks, with pale sweeping wash bands, rows of short vertical marsh/rice strokes, scattered dark stones or earth clumps, and a curved shrub-dotted embankment at the upper edge. Avoid the large willow trunks as separate elements.
must_preserve: broad pale grey wash bands following the field slope
rows of tiny vertical grass or rice shoots
thin horizontal dike and waterline strokes
small dark stone or earth-clump accents
curved embankment with blue-green shrub dots

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
